column1: # The checks of shell/name-value-password.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# A PASSWORD on a VARSTORE_NAME_VALUE, whose values its driver exposes, as UEFI 2.11 §33.2.5.6 says,
# through EFI_HII_CONFIG_ACCESS_PROTOCOL, in storage of its own choosing, could keep its password in
# any variable, so get, keyword get, list-questions and set read and write none, of either package
# list, even with --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system, which lifts none of that, so set warns of
# nothing, and nothing shows 0x7A5BC3E1, which NvBacking holds where the password may be

column3: . == {"error_message": "PASSWORD question 0x0003 in FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001F00: HII name/value varstore requires EFI_HII_CONFIG_ACCESS_PROTOCOL; as the variable of that password is unknown, the UEFI Shell build reads and writes no variable of this HiiDB"}

(.error_message | contains("PASSWORD question 0x0003 in FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001F00: HII name/value varstore requires EFI_HII_CONFIG_ACCESS_PROTOCOL") and endswith("; as the variable of that password is unknown, the UEFI Shell build reads and writes no variable of this HiiDB"))
